pose: 半身微侧，双手轻握袖口
art_direction: 阿妙束发与端整浅色衣着融入水粉浅紫画面，轻握袖口的日常手势温柔自然。
composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Paint Tae Shimura with her familiar gathered dark hair and gentle adult face, wearing a modest pale lavender kimono with a cream inner collar. Her hands meet quietly at the lower chest, holding a sleeve edge rather than forming a dramatic gesture. She looks nearly straight toward the viewer with a warm small smile. Use opaque gouache, broad lilac and warm-white background areas, and restrained folds around the sleeves. Keep the hair shape clear and both eyes unobstructed. Avoid ornate accessories or a detailed room; the face, modest hand gesture, and balanced shoulders should carry the portrait. Inside both visible irises, place a red Mangekyo-inspired design using an original simple rotating black petal pattern, a clear pupil, and bright catchlights; the marks stay entirely inside the irises. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for recognizable character, readable requested eye motif, appealing expression, original nonviolent composition, coherent anatomy, no text or watermark
